compose_config.output_tail:
5s
      interval: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 20s
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    networks:
      agentco-net: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 5432
        published: "5432"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: postgres-data
        target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
        volume: {}
  prometheus:
    command:
      - --config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
      - --storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus
      - --storage.tsdb.retention.time=15d
      - --web.enable-lifecycle
    container_name: agentco-prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - wget -qO- http://localhost:9090/-/healthy | grep -q Healthy
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 15s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.52.0
    networks:
      agentco-net: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 9090
        published: "9090"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /Users/Zet/Agentco/infrastructure/prometheus/prometheus.yml
        target: /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
      - type: volume
        source: prometheus-data
        target: /prometheus
        volume: {}
  redis:
    command:
      - redis-server
      - --save
      - "60"
      - "1"
      - --loglevel
      - warning
    container_name: agentco-redis
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - redis-cli
        - ping
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    image: redis:7-alpine
    networks:
      agentco-net: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 6379
        published: "6379"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: redis-data
        target: /data
        volume: {}
  vault:
    cap_add:
      - IPC_LOCK
    command:
      - server
      - -dev
    container_name: agentco-vault
    environment:
      VAULT_ADDR: http://0.0.0.0:8200
      VAULT_DEV_LISTEN_ADDRESS: 0.0.0.0:8200
      VAULT_DEV_ROOT_TOKEN_ID: root
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - vault status -address=http://localhost:8200
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    image: hashicorp/vault:1.16
    networks:
      agentco-net: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 8200
        published: "8200"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: vault-data
        target: /vault/data
        volume: {}
      - type: bind
        source: /Users/Zet/Agentco/infrastructure/vault/policies.hcl
        target: /vault/config/policies.hcl
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
  zookeeper:
    container_name: agentco-zookeeper
    environment:
      ZOOKEEPER_4LW_COMMANDS_WHITELIST: ruok,stat,mntr,conf
      ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT: "2181"
      ZOOKEEPER_SYNC_LIMIT: "2"
      ZOOKEEPER_TICK_TIME: "2000"
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - bash -ec 'cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/localhost/2181'
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 10s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 30s
    image: confluentinc/cp-zookeeper:7.6.1
    networks:
      agentco-net: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 2181
        published: "2181"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: zookeeper-data
        target: /var/lib/zookeeper/data
        volume: {}
networks:
  agentco-net:
    name: agentco_agentco-net
    driver: bridge
volumes:
  grafana-data:
    name: agentco_grafana-data
  kafka-data:
    name: agentco_kafka-data
  postgres-data:
    name: agentco_postgres-data
  prometheus-data:
    name: agentco_prometheus-data
  redis-data:
    name: agentco_redis-data
  vault-data:
    name: agentco_vault-data
  zookeeper-data:
    name: agentco_zookeeper-data
